description: This file provides authentication services, including user signup and login functions, utilizing password hashing, token creation, and database interactions.

methods.name: str _hash_password(password: str)
methods.description: Hashes a password using SHA-256 with a salt.

methods.name: bool _check_password(password: str, password_hash: str)
methods.description: Checks if a password matches the stored hash.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] signup(db: DatabaseInterface, email: str, password: str, name: Optional[str])
methods.description: Creates a new user in the database and returns an authentication token and user profile.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] login(db: DatabaseInterface, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Authenticates a user and returns an authentication token and user profile if credentials are valid.

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^def login(db: DatabaseInterface, email: str, password: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: signup
ctags.pattern: /^def signup(db: DatabaseInterface, email: str, password: str, name: Optional[str]) -> Dict[str, A/
ctags.signature: (db: DatabaseInterface, email: str, password: str, name: Optional[str])
